title: Integrability under correlated Gaussian measure
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\gamma_n$ be the product of $n$ standard Gaussian measures on $\mathbb R^n$, and let $\rho\in[-1,1]$. Form a pair $(X,Y)$ by taking independent vectors $U,V$ with law $\gamma_n$ and setting $X=U$ and $Y=\rho U+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,V$; denote the law of $(X,Y)$ by $\mu_\rho$. If $f,g:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ each belong to $L^2(\gamma_n)$, then $(x,y)\mapsto f(x)g(y)$ is integrable with respect to $\mu_\rho$.
